 Explore several landmarks at Peninsula State Park on this E-bike tour
Discover the natural beauty of Peninsula State Park on a fun Door County E-bike tour! This tour takes you to one of the most popular state parks in Wisconsin,

The Skyline Road and Sunset trail in Peninsula State Park have the best views of any of the Door County State Parks. Come see for yourself on this Door County e-bike tour.

Discover the history of the area and experience the beauty of the park and Fish Creek on this e-bike tour. We stop at several water views that give you magnificent views of Green Bay and the islands off the shore including Chambers, Horseshoe, and the Strawberry Islands.

The Ebike will carry you effortlessly up and down the hills on our most popular tour. This is the best way to see Peninsula State Park without spending too much time or having to walk too far.
